documents.title: Fetch API
documents.summary: The Fetch API provides an interface for fetching resources (including across the network). It is a more powerful and flexible replacement for XMLHttpRequest.

body: The <mark>Fetch API</mark> provides an interface for fetching resources (including across the network).
The <mark>Fetch API</mark> uses Request and Response objects (and other things involved with network requests), as well as related concepts
Find out more about using the <mark>Fetch API</mark> features in Using <mark>Fetch</mark>.
title: <mark>Fetch API</mark>

documents.title: Using the Fetch API
documents.summary: The Fetch API provides a JavaScript interface for making HTTP requests and processing the responses.

body: The <mark>Fetch API</mark> provides a JavaScript interface for making HTTP requests and processing the responses.
With the <mark>Fetch API</mark>, you make a request by calling <mark>fetch</mark>(), which is available as a global function in both window and worker
In the context of the <mark>Fetch API</mark>, a credential is an extra piece of data sent along with the request that the server may use

documents.title: Background Fetch API
documents.summary: The Background Fetch API provides a method for managing downloads that may take a significant amount of time such as movies, audio files, and software.

body: The Background <mark>Fetch API</mark> provides a method for managing downloads that may take a significant amount of time such as movies
The Background <mark>Fetch API</mark> solves this problem.
The Background <mark>Fetch API</mark> will enable the <mark>fetch</mark> to happen if the user starts the process while offline.
